items.evidence_quote: On October 21, 2026, Sam Altman sat down with Matthew Berman for a 45-minute interview on Berman's YouTube channel.

figure.quote_en: I want to be clear. No one really knows.
figure.summary_zh: 奧特曼於 10 月 21 日接受 YouTube 頻道 Matthew Berman 45 分鐘訪談。當被問及現今模型是否具意識，他表示相信不是，「就算有，也是極其奇怪的形式」，並直言「沒人真正知道」。

items.evidence_quote: Demis Hassabis now expects artificial general intelligence (AGI) within two to three years.

figure.quote_en: It's soon. I'm updating nearer and nearer.
figure.summary_zh: 哈薩比斯在 10 月 21 日刊出的《華爾街日報》專訪中，將通用人工智能到來的預測由年初的 3 至 5 年提前至 2 至 3 年。他定義 AGI 為擁有與人類大腦同等完整認知範圍的系統。

items.evidence_quote: On October 21, 2026, the Anthropic CEO posted a long reply on X to Nathan Calvin, chief strategy officer at the AI policy nonprofit Encode.

figure.quote_en: I disagree with the thrust of your post.
figure.summary_zh: 安莫迪 10 月 21 日在 X 長文逐點回應 Encode 的 Nathan Calvin 九項批評，以「race to the top」為核心辯護，列出九項耗費商業利益但有利安全的決策，並承認三項溝通失誤、由他本人負責。

items.evidence_quote: Zuckerberg said about 25% of people who set up Muse now use it daily, helping improve retention.

figure.quote_en: Now that Muse has achieved product-market fit, we are entering a new phase and a more operational phase that is focused on scaling it.
figure.summary_zh: 祖克柏在 10 月 21 日 Meta 第三季財報電話會議上表示，AI 助理 Muse 已有超過 1,000 萬用戶、約四分一每日使用，購物為最常見用途，平均每單逾 200 美元；他指 Muse 已達 product-market fit，下一步是規模化、營收與優化算力成本。

items.evidence_quote: Mustafa Suleyman, Microsoft AI's CEO, called the result a step toward "medical superintelligence."

figure.quote_en: The system, dubbed MAI-DxO (DxO for short), coordinates several AI agents that act like a panel of doctors.
figure.summary_zh: 蘇萊曼 10 月 22 日就發表於《Science》的研究發言：微軟 AI 診斷系統 MAI-DxO 在複雜病例模擬中診斷正確率 83%，逾全科醫生兩倍。他稱此為邁向「醫療超級智能」的一步。

items.evidence_quote: He proposed that a government agency review statistical evidence of chatbot safety before launch.

figure.quote_en: Hinton described the chance of AI destroying humanity as significant and greater than 1%.
figure.summary_zh: 辛頓在 10 月 21 日刊出的《EL PAÍS》訪談中，將 AI 毀滅人類的機率定為大於 1%，屬其個人判斷；並主張聊天機器人上線前須先以統計證據向政府機構證明安全性。

items.evidence_quote: Andrew Ng criticized AI chatbots as poor learning tools at the NDTV World Summit on October 22, 2026.

figure.quote_en: When students ask a chatbot for an answer, they bypass the cognitive struggle that builds mastery
figure.summary_zh: 吳恩達 10 月 22 日在新德里 NDTV 世界峰會上批評 AI 聊天機械人是「學習的殺手」，指即問即答界面繞過了建立精通所需的認知掙扎，主張以蘇格拉底式方法與迭代解題重新設計教育用 AI。

items.evidence_quote: NVIDIA opened GTC Berlin on Wednesday with CEO Jensen Huang using his keynote to argue that AI infrastructure is becoming a new industrial base

figure.quote_en: To be part of this AI economy, you don't want to just be consuming the AI; you want to be producing the AI.
figure.summary_zh: 黃仁勳 10 月 21 日在 GTC Berlin 主題演講中將 AI 基建定位為新工業革命基礎，稱英偉達一週內在歐洲（巴黎、倫敦、斯德哥爾摩、都柏林）投入近 100 億美元，並主張各國不應只消費 AI，更要生產 AI。

items.evidence_quote: Nadella noted that "Super Intelligence" is changing every organisation's inputs and outputs

figure.quote_en: As a result, customers will increasingly measure the cost of tokens against the outcomes they produce
figure.summary_zh: 納德拉在微軟年度信函中提出「成本—成果邊界」：客戶將以 token 成本對應的成果來衡量價值，微軟重點是令 AI 可靠、穩定、可預測，而非追逐新奇；同時擴建 frontier 生態系。

items.evidence_quote: That is such an aggressive language for a profession where people set out to help

figure.quote_en: We sat down with Perel to talk about the language of a gladiator profession, why the corporate world stopped filing relational skills under 'soft,' the peer groups lawyers don't have and badly need, and what a client's trust is actually built out of.
figure.summary_zh: Perel 接受 IR Global 訪問，談律師業的「戰士式語言」（說服、摧毀、打贏）如何侵蝕信任，以及客戶信任的真正基礎；也談到關係技能不再被當成「軟技能」、律師缺乏同儕支持團體，以及病人為她做的 AI 分身。

items.evidence_quote: COMING October 20, 2026 – Published by W. W. Norton

figure.quote_en: A practical, direct-immersion, high-emotion, low-techno-speak book, The Mindful Therapist engages readers in a personal and professional journey into the ideas and processes of mindful integration that lie at the heart of health and nurturing relationships.
figure.summary_zh: Siegel 官網宣布《The Mindful Therapist》第二版 10 月 20 日出版（W. W. Norton），新版納入十五年的人際神經生物學研究，聚焦治療師的正念臨在如何促進療癒。

figure.summary_zh: Fisher 在自己 Podcast《In Conversation with Janina Fisher》最新一集（10/21）與創傷治療師 Mariah Rooney 對談：被標籤為「不適應」的行為其實是高明的生存策略，並質疑實證治療與診斷標籤的局限。

items.evidence_quote: Close enough to have the information, far enough away to be able to do nothing.

figure.summary_zh: Dr. Becky 與 Hot Wheels 合作的新限定系列《Challenge Accepted》首集（10/20）訪談太空人 Kellie Gerardi：自信不是相信自己會成功，而是知道失敗後自己能挺過；Gerardi 分享父母認真看待她興趣的身教。
